Work in pairs. Talk about these questions.

1. Do you have any root other than the place where you are living now? If yes, where is it and who live there? If not, why not?

2. How do you label your roots?

I have my roots in

[ ] a remote rural village [ ] a village [ ] a semi-urban area (upazila)

[ ] a small town [ ] a midsize city [ ] a suburb [ ] a city

3. Do you feel any attraction for your roots?

4. How do you nourish your roots?

5. What, according to you, are the reasons why people become rootless?
Make a classroom survey and present in a chart the types of roots your classmates have.
